title: Making record
description: The generator's record of a round, generator.json in the round's folder: what it made, the commands that try it, each small point it decided, and each point it found open.

made.description: Each file the generator made or changed, from the top of the repository, the deliverable's files and their tests among them.

commands.description: Each command the deliverable's people run to use it, in order, as they would type it, such as its install steps and its walkthrough, which throwaway.py runs in a throwaway copy.

home.description: Each file outside the repository those commands need, by its path under the home, such as Downloads/a.jpg, made empty in the throwaway home.

decided.description: Each small point of making it that the generator decided, such as a phrase, with what settles it.

intent.description: The intent the point bears on, by its ID in the best practice.

about.description: What the point is about, in a few words.

grounds.description: What settles it, such as a best practice, or a deliverable it takes from.

open.description: Each point the design leaves open, which the generator doesn't decide.

intent.description: The intent the point bears on, by its ID.

about.description: What the point is about, in a few words.

what.description: The point, as the main conversation would settle it.
